pages.title: A placa na mesa
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Hessa places the numbered copper tariff plate beside her father's private receipt; Ordelia writes its serial without stamping it authentic yet.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Esta placa ficou guardada com o recibo.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A sequência deve aparecer em outro livro.

pages.title: O livro da Enseada
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Adult gnome Pim arrives from the Enseada carrying the independently kept public tariff ledger; Hessa watches him open the bound volume.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Trouxe o livro do conselho. Não saiu de lá antes de hoje.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Procure a tarifa de meu pai pelo número.

pages.title: Dois registros
pages.layout: single wide environmental panel with two separated foreground figures
pages.scene: Ordelia and Runa match serial and salt fee in the two separate records; a small visual inset shows Pim's rope-knot sketch made before seeing Mira's old drawing.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Número e valor conferem em livros de guarda diferente.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: O nó também foi desenhado sem olhar o caderno.

pages.title: A estação da casca
pages.layout: asymmetric comic panel with a small evidence inset
pages.scene: Neral and Ysra enter with the ORIGINAL bark strip and sealed glass case; Neral points to three seasonal marks beside an independent human calendar.

lines.speaker: Neral
lines.text: Esta marca é do inverno seguinte à partida dela.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: O conselho preservou a tira original.

pages.title: Lacres e testemunhas
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Eda and Ordelia log both seals and custody witnesses before opening the sealed glass case on the archive desk; others remain secondary, no one touches the letter yet.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Registre quem trouxe, quem recebeu e cada lacre.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Só abriremos diante das testemunhas.

pages.title: A folha de Mira
pages.layout: single wide environmental panel with two separated foreground figures
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa witness the opened letter under a mundane oil lamp; the script is decorative and illegible, the glass case and broken old wax are visible.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: É a letra dela. Ainda precisamos do resto.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A marca da forja aparece aqui, por dentro.

pages.title: A dívida de água
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Adra and Ilyan read the page explaining the old counterweights and inhabitants of both margins; a small inset shows salt wall and reed village, no new portal.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Ela não queria entregar a rota a um único gabinete.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Porque a passagem atravessa casas habitadas.

pages.title: O que não prometeu
pages.layout: asymmetric comic panel with a small evidence inset
pages.scene: Ilyan reads his mother's final paragraph while Ordelia keeps the original letter on the table, weighing the grief rather than celebrating a solved disappearance.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ela não prometeu voltar. Só pediu que eu soubesse por quê.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A folha prova uma data. Não o lugar dela hoje.

pages.title: Um corredor inteiro
pages.layout: single wide environmental panel with two separated foreground figures
pages.scene: Ilyan has walked physically into the archive corridor to breathe; Runa joins only after he beckons and keeps respectful space.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quero procurá-la. Também quero falar com meu pai.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Nenhuma das duas escolhas precisa ser hoje.

pages.title: Quatro maneiras de falhar
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Caio and Tovo give separate bridge testimony before Oru and a classroom diagram: redirected air failed; muscle surge hurt Tovo's shoulder; the teacher listens.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Inverti o ar e quase levei o frio à ponte.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Segurei a travessa até o ombro mandar parar.

pages.title: A fratura assinada
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Líria places her own witnessed fracture sketch in the file, never falsifying it; she and Runa face each other with unresolved hostility and separate workspaces.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: A fissura pode ceder se voltarmos depressa.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Avisarei Adra. Isso não muda o que houve entre nós.

pages.title: A versão pública
pages.layout: asymmetric comic panel with a small evidence inset
pages.scene: Eda presents a public summary with protected map annex; Hessa checks that her inhabited port is named and not presented as ruin; closed folder conceals exact route.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Publicaremos as provas, não a trilha protegida.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Escreva Porto das Cinzas como povoado vivo.

pages.title: Duas cartas
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: Ilyan writes separate ordinary letters to Bram and Nima at the archive desk, with no magical delivery, while Ordelia seals only a certified public excerpt for his father.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Meu pai recebe a cópia autenticada. Nima, só o que posso contar.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: As cartas seguirão pelo correio comum.

pages.title: Uma mecha existente
pages.layout: two unequal comic panels with a clear establishing view
pages.scene: In the SAME red-brick east forge, Ilyan guides a tiny flame only from existing charcoal to a contained wick, then covers it; Oru watches, water bucket close by.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A chama veio do carvão. A mecha já se apaga.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Então feche a fonte antes de sair.

pages.title: O aviso da margem
pages.layout: single wide environmental panel with two separated foreground figures
pages.scene: Adra brings the Enseada council's physical written notice that the seam remains closed and watched; Ordelia pins class schedules under it, no secret travel order.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A costura continua fechada e vigiada.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: As aulas retomam. A investigação também.

pages.title: Um lugar sem trilha
pages.layout: asymmetric comic panel with a small evidence inset
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa sit in the familiar observatory above lit school windows, two warm mugs beside a public map that names the port but leaves protected route blank; quiet arc-ending vista.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ainda não sei se a perdoo. Mas sei o que perguntar.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então começaremos pelas perguntas certas.
